title: The Dahlia | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'The Dahlia’, professionally managed by Stay on 30a! This stunning multi-level coastal retreat sleeps up to 16 guests and is designed for effortless luxury and laid-back 30A living. It features four spacious king bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, plus a bunk room with four queen beds, making it perfect for families and groups traveling together. The primary suite is located on the first floor for added privacy and convenience, and with 6.5 bathrooms, everyone can enjoy space and comfort throughout their stay. Living areas on both the first and third floors create a natural flow for gathering, relaxing, and spreading out, with the fully equipped kitchen located on the first floor for easy access and everyday convenience. The third-floor balcony offers an outdoor kitchen ideal for sunset dinners and evening cocktails, while the fourth-floor observation deck provides sweeping panoramic views of the coast. An arcade machine adds a fun, playful touch. Located in The Grove at Inlet, this home sits within a charming boutique community of just nine beach homes, offering a secluded pool, green space, and easy walkability to Highway 98’s scenic path. With a true small-village feel and quick access to all that 30A has to offer, this is the ideal home base for your family’s beach getaway, where mornings start with salty air and evenings end under glowing coastal skies. Designed for unforgettable 30A escapes, this home blends coastal elegance with resort-style comfort, giving your group the perfect place to relax, reconnect, and soak in every moment of beachside living. Luxury Village Feel: Tucked within a single, thoughtfully designed block, The Grove at Inlet features just nine upscale beach homes, a private community pool, and a spacious green area for gathering and play. With direct pedestrian access to Highway 98’s scenic walking path, this intimate enclave offers a true village-style experience perfect for families seeking a refined and relaxed 30A beach escape. Unbeatable 30A Location: Perfectly positioned near the heart of it all, this newer neighborhood delivers easy access without the crowds. Enjoy a short walk to Rosemary Beach, 30Avenue, and nearby dining and shopping, while retreating back to a quieter, more peaceful setting. This is coastal living done right and 30A vacationing at its finest. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Gulf Views -6 Adult Bikes -4 Minute Walk From the Gulf -Community Pool -Spacious Porches -Green Space -Observation Deck With Panoramic Views -Arcade machine -Third Floor Balcony + Outdoor Kitchen -4 Dedicated Parking Spots -Short walk to Rosemary Beach -First Floor Master Bedroom -Fully Equipped Kitchen BEACH ACCESS Two access points, just a short walk from the home: 1. Inlet Beach Public Access. This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. 2. Wall Street Beach Public Access. This access is at the end of South Wall Street. About 200 yards east of the intersection of Scenic 30A and Hwy 98, turn south on to South Wall Street then proceed two blocks to the dead end at the gulf. There is no parking but there is plenty of parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Four parking spaces available (4 driveway). No street parking allowed. Included is 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 16 FIRST FLOOR: Bedroom #1- King, Ensuite Bathroom SECOND FLOOR: Bedroom #2- King, Ensuite Bathroom Bedroom #3- (2) Queen/Queen Bunks Bedroom #4- King, Ensuite Bathroom THIRD FLOOR: Bedroom #5- King, Ensuite Bathroom HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
